title: A technician with only internal hours shows 0.0% utilization, and utilization never exceeds 100%
refs: specs/technician-utilization.md S2-E1; S2-R7; S2 context note
custom_preconds:
1. A technician with internal hours but ZERO work-order hours in the range.
2. Other technicians with mixed hours for the upper-bound check.
custom_steps:
1. Read the internal-only technician's Utilization %.
2. Scan every row's Utilization %.
custom_expected:
1. The internal-only technician shows "0.0%".
2. No row shows more than 100% - work-order hours are always part of total clocked hours.
3. The "—" (undefined, total = 0) state is unreachable on a rendered technician or day row, because only technicians with clocked time get rows.
